name: Lakeville Winter Scramble
oneLiner: Fourteen weeks of it, January through mid-April, with each night run as its own league rather than pooled — twelve weeks of regular play and two of playoffs.
beginnerNote: Same forgiving format as the fall: both of you hit, you play the better ball. Fourteen weeks is long enough that a rough first night stops mattering by February.
prizes: Top 4 teams played off for 1st, 2nd and 3rd
nextSeasonNote: This is how it ran last winter. Check back for the updated 2026 fall schedule.
